description: Convx 1.8 — Canvas Position & Fit for Ambient Mode. Portrait canvases (3:4 and 9:16) now keep their full frame in a panel anchored to one side of the 16:9 layout instead of being cropped to cover the whole screen, the flat dim is replaced by an adjustable asymmetric gradient, and a live preview in Settings shows how the canvas sits in the layout while you tune it.

changelog.title: Ambient Mode — Canvas Position & Fit
items: Portrait canvases (3:4 and 9:16) no longer get cropped to cover the whole 16:9 layout. With Canvas Position & Fit they keep their full frame, fitted at full size into a panel anchored to one side of the screen.

The flat full-screen dim is now an asymmetric gradient: stronger on the canvas side, lighter on the side where the lyrics and the progress ring sit, with the panel edge feathered into the ambient glow so the canvas reads as part of the scene instead of a rectangle pasted onto it.

Everything is adjustable under Settings → Ambient Mode: which side the canvas anchors to (Auto follows the album artwork side, opposite the lyrics, or Left/Right), how the frame is fitted (Fit shows it whole, Fill side covers the panel and crops the edges, Stretch ignores the aspect ratio), side width, canvas-side gradient, gradient spread, lyrics-side gradient, and edge feather.
Landscape canvases keep the ordinary full-width background, and turning the option off restores the previous behaviour exactly.

changelog.title: Live preview in the settings
items: Settings → Ambient Mode now shows a live preview of the layout at the top of the Canvas Position & Fit section. Pick a canvas shape (9:16, 3:4, 16:9) and the panel, crop and gradient follow the sliders as you drag them — it is driven by the same geometry the Ambient screen itself draws from.
A caption under the preview reports the resulting panel share of the width, or why no panel is in use: video canvas off, the option off, or the canvas not being a portrait one.

changelog.title: Documentation
items: The repository now ships docs/AMBIENT_MODE.md, a guide to Ambient Mode's layout and every Canvas Position & Fit setting.
